topic: 非谓语动词全面攻克（不定式、动名词与分词）
teaching_notes:
1. 【核心概念】：把非谓语动词想象成动词的“变装大作战”！在一个标准的英语句子中，主句只能有一个真正的“动词国王”（谓语动词）。如果还想加入其他动作，其他动词就必须变装，穿上不定式（to do，表将来/目的）、动名词（doing，表习惯/名词化）或分词（doing/done，表正在进行或被动修饰）的外套出场。
2. 【语法公式与口诀】：
   - 公式：主语 + 谓语动词 + (to do / doing / done)
   - 口诀：“喜欢完成 enjoy/finish 用 doing，决定想要 want/decide 带 to do；介词后面要加 -ing，使役感官动词省去 to！”
3. 【中小学生易错点】：
   - 易错点1：两动词相连忘记变装（❌ I want go shopping. -> ✅ I want to go shopping.）。
   - 易错点2：介词（in/at/on/of/about/to）后误用原形（❌ look forward to see you -> ✅ look forward to seeing you）。
   - 易错点3：感官/使役动词变被动语态时忘记补回 to（❌ He was seen enter the room. -> ✅ He was seen to enter the room.）。
4. 【经典例句】：
   - She decided to learn French next term.（她决定下学期学习法语。——不定式做宾语）
   - My brother is fond of playing chess.（我哥哥喜欢下国际象棋。——介词后接动名词）
   - Hearing the funny story, the children laughed aloud.（听到这个有趣的故事，孩子们大笑了起来。——现在分词做状语）

questions.question: I want _____ a new bicycle for my upcoming birthday.
questions.explanation: 动词 want 后面固定跟动词不定式做宾语，即 want to do sth.（想要做某事）。

questions.question: My little sister enjoys _____ computer games after finishing her homework.
questions.explanation: 动词 enjoy 后面接动名词做宾语，即 enjoy doing sth.（喜欢做某事）。

questions.question: Don't forget _____ off the lights when you leave the classroom.
questions.explanation: forget to do sth. 表示“记得要做某事（未做）”；forget doing sth. 表示“忘记做过某事（已做）”。离开教室前要记得关灯，动作尚未发生，用 to turn。

questions.question: My parents plan _____ to Beijing for our summer holiday.
questions.explanation: plan to do sth. 是固定搭配，意为“计划做某事”。

questions.question: Thank you for _____ me with my English homework.
questions.explanation: 介词 for 后面需要接动名词（v-ing）形式做宾语。

questions.question: The strict teacher made the students _____ the text twice.
questions.explanation: 使役动词 make 后接不带 to 的不定式（即动词原形）做宾语补足语，公式：make sb. do sth.。

questions.question: We were very tired, so we stopped _____ a rest under the tree.
questions.explanation: stop to do sth. 表示“停下来去执行另一件事”；stop doing sth. 表示“停止正在做的事”。此处指停下脚步去休息，选 to take。

questions.question: Lucy practices _____ the piano every afternoon.
questions.explanation: practice 是接动名词做宾语的常见动词，搭配为 practice doing sth.（练习做某事）。

questions.question: It is necessary for children _____ enough water every day.
questions.explanation: 句型：It is + adj. + for sb. + to do sth.，其中 It 为形式主语，真正的动词主语是不定式结构。

questions.question: He left the meeting room without _____ anything to his colleagues.
questions.explanation: without 是介词，后面接动词时必须使用动名词（saying）。

questions.question: Tim finished _____ his science project at 9:00 p.m. last night.
questions.explanation: finish 后只接动名词作宾语，即 finish doing sth.（完成做某事）。

questions.question: I saw a little boy _____ happily in the playground just now.
questions.explanation: see sb. doing sth. 强调“看到某人正在做某事”；see sb. do sth. 强调“看到动作全过程”。此处指刚刚看到那个男孩正在开心跑步，用 running 最自然。

questions.question: My mother spends half an hour _____ delicious breakfast every morning.
questions.explanation: sb. spend + 时间/金钱 + (in) doing sth. 是固定句式，空格处需填写动名词 cooking。

questions.question: We are looking forward to _____ our grandparents in the countryside.
questions.explanation: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，而不是动词不定式符号，后面必须接动名词 visiting。

questions.question: The baby is sleeping. Please try not _____ any noise.
questions.explanation: try to do sth. 表示“尽力去做某事”，其否定形式为 try not to do sth.。

questions.question: The news was so _____ that all the students were greatly _____.
questions.explanation: 现在分词（inspiring）常用来修饰物，表示“令人……的”；过去分词（inspired）常用来修饰人，表示“感到……的”。

questions.question: Having failed three times, he decided to have another try, _____ that practice makes perfect.
questions.explanation: believing 引导现在分词短语作伴随状语，分词与主语 he 之间为主动关系。

questions.question: Before going abroad, you'd better have your computer _____ by a specialist.
questions.explanation: have sth. done 表示“让某事被处理/请别人做某事”。computer 与 check 之间是动宾（被动）关系，故用过去分词 checked。

questions.question: The problem is too complex for a ten-year-old child _____ in such a short time.
questions.explanation: 在“too... for sb. to do sth.”句型中，主语 the problem 与动词 solve 构成逻辑上的动宾关系，且在句末作状语，习惯上用不定式的主动形式表达被动意义。

questions.question: _____ the task ahead of time, the team leader praised all members in the meeting.
questions.explanation: 完成时态的现在分词 Having completed 作时间/原因状语，表示该动作（完成任务）发生在主句谓语动词（praise）之前。

questions.question: He pretended _____ the bad news when I walked into his room.
questions.explanation: pretend 后接动词不定式 pretend to do sth.，其否定形式是在 to 前加 not，即 pretend not to do sth.。

questions.question: The municipal government took effective measures to prevent the disease from _____.
questions.explanation: prevent sb./sth. from doing sth. 是固定高频搭配，意为“阻止……做某事/发生”，介词 from 后接动名词 spreading。

questions.question: _____ by the heavy storm, the flight to London was delayed for three hours.
questions.explanation: 过去分词短语 Affected by... 作状语，逻辑主语是 the flight，flight 与 affect 是被动关系（航班受到暴风雨影响）。

questions.question: I regretted _____ Mark the truth because it made him extremely upset.
questions.explanation: regret doing sth. 表示“后悔曾经做过某事”（已发生）；regret to do sth. 表示“对即将做的事感到遗憾/抱歉”（未发生）。这里指对“已经告诉马克真相”感到后悔，故选 telling。

questions.question: With all the tasks _____, the manager allowed the staff to leave early.
questions.explanation: With + 宾语 + 宾补（复合结构）。tasks 与 complete 之间是被动关系，表示“所有任务均已被完成”，因此使用过去分词 completed 做宾补。

questions.question: The suspect admitted _____ into the store and taking the gold ring.
questions.explanation: admit 表示“承认”，后面跟动名词作宾语，即 admit doing sth.（也可跟 admit to doing sth.，但直接跟 -ing 最普遍）。

questions.question: The thief was noticed _____ into the bank through the back door late at night.
questions.explanation: 在主动语态中，感官动词 notice sb. do sth. 省去 to；但在变被动语态（sb. be noticed ...）时，必须将动词不定式符号 to 还原补回，即 be noticed to do sth.。

questions.question: _____ in the library for hours, David finally solved the math problem.
questions.explanation: David（主语）在图书馆研究了数小时这一动作发生在“解决问题”（solved）之前，因此用完成时分词 Having worked 作时间状语。

questions.question: The dedicated professor devoted all his energy to _____ environmental pollution.
questions.explanation: devote... to... 结构中的 to 是介词（相当于 dedicate to / pay attention to），后面必须跟名词或动名词形式（tackling）。

questions.question: It is report that the old building said _____ in the 19th century will be renovated soon.
questions.explanation: sb./sth. is said to do... 句型中，建造动作发生在 19 世纪（过去），且 old building 与 build 属于被动关系，因此使用不定式的完成被动形式 to have been built。
